_note: Publicly available third-party research used to show how the evidence assistant weighs different kinds of evidence. These are NOT BPI studies and are always labelled 'Public source'. The PDFs are not committed: run `python scripts/fetch_public_reports.py` from backend/ to download them into data/public/pdfs/ (git-ignored). Licences differ; several are 'all rights reserved' and are used here only for internal evaluation, with short attributed quotations. Check the licence before any wider use.

reports.title: 2021 Financial Inclusion Survey (Topline Report)
reports.license: BSP website Terms of Use: contents may be quoted, copied or reproduced in whole or in part provided the BSP is duly credited (no licence statement in the PDF itself).
reports.method_detail: Nationally representative face-to-face survey (CAPI, multi-stage random sampling) of adults 15+, plus 6 consumer FGDs, 1 FSP FGD, and business-owner IDIs and FGD.
reports.fieldwork: 13 January - 9 February 2022 (survey, reference year 2021); FGDs and IDIs 17-26 May 2022
reports.download_note: bsp.gov.ph sometimes refuses scripted downloads (HTTP 403 bot protection; the fetch script worked on 30 Oct 2026). If it fails, open the URL in a browser and save the file as data/public/pdfs/<slug>.pdf; --check then verifies its sha256.

reports.title: Consumer Expectations Survey Report, 4th Quarter 2025
reports.license: BSP website Terms of Use: contents may be quoted, copied or reproduced in whole or in part provided the BSP is duly credited (no licence statement in the PDF itself).
reports.method_detail: Quarterly household sentiment survey; stratified multi-stage probability sample from the PSA 2023 Geo-Enabled Master Sample.
reports.download_note: bsp.gov.ph sometimes refuses scripted downloads (HTTP 403). If the fetch script fails, save the file manually as data/public/pdfs/<slug>.pdf.

reports.title: Enterprise Surveys: Philippines 2023 Country Profile
reports.license: (c) 2024 IBRD/The World Bank. 'This work may be reproduced, in whole or in part, for noncommercial purposes as long as full attribution to this work is given.' (PDF p.2)
reports.method_detail: Representative survey of formal, non-agricultural private firms with 5+ employees, stratified by sector, size and region; interviews with owners and top managers.

reports.title: Asia Small and Medium-Sized Enterprise Monitor 2020, Volume III: Thematic Chapter - Fintech Loans to Tricycle Drivers in the Philippines
reports.license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 IGO (CC BY 3.0 IGO); does not apply to non-ADB copyright materials in the publication (PDF p.4).
reports.method_detail: Baseline survey of randomly sampled self-employed tricycle drivers (fintech-loan and conventional) in Metro Manila, with regression analysis.
reports.download_note: adb.org refuses scripted downloads (HTTP 403 bot protection, confirmed 30 Oct 2026). Open the URL in a browser and save the file as data/public/pdfs/<slug>.pdf; --check then verifies its sha256.

reports.title: Filipino Financial Customers' Views on Customer Empowerment: Report from the Field
reports.license: No licence statement in the PDF. Treat as all rights reserved (CGAP/World Bank); used for internal evaluation with short attributed quotations only.
reports.method_detail: Nine focus groups and 15 individual interviews with low-income financial customers (mostly microfinance clients) recruited through two financial service providers.

reports.title: Striving for E-payments at Scale: The Evolution of the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program in the Philippines
reports.license: (c) 2013, CGAP/World Bank. All rights reserved. (PDF p.2) Used for internal evaluation with short attributed quotations only.
reports.method_detail: Case study based on in-person interviews with government, the paying bank, payment conduits and recipients, plus staff questionnaires.
